title: The Bat Roost
text: Ten thousand bats hang from the ceiling of the passage, wings folded, shifting and squeaking in their sleep. The air is hot with them. The floor is deep in their droppings, and every step you take sinks to the ankle.

options.label: Creep under them, slow and silent, and do not wake the ceiling.

outcomes.text: They sleep. Under the droppings you find the bones of the last party that tried, and a little of what they carried.
They sleep. The droppings are another matter: by evening every scratch in the party is red and hot.
They wake. Ten thousand of them, screaming, in your hair and your eyes and your mouths.

options.label: Gather the guano. It is foul work, but the smiths pay well for it.

outcomes.text: Foul work, and profitable. The smell will take a week to leave you.

options.label: The strongest drives them out with a torch, and clears the way by force.

outcomes.text: They go in a black storm, and something big that eats them comes in after them, and it is still hungry.
